external_commits.message:
Synchronize generated crate READMEs

Root README gained the WebAssembly and browser prerequisites without
running just gen, so gen-check reported two stale crate copies.
Regenerate with go run ./tools/specgen.

Name the playground package install before Playwright

Fresh checkouts ran the documented Playwright install before the
playground packages existed. Name pnpm install first, then regenerate
the crate copies with go run ./tools/specgen.

Match ordinary and verbatim drive prefixes by letter

relative_url compared resolved components for equality, so an
ordinary host with a verbatim asset dir (or the reverse) on the same
Windows drive failed with cannot make asset path relative to host.
Compare the leading components with same_volume, which treats Disk and
VerbatimDisk with the same letter as one volume for URL comparison
only; resolved paths keep their spelling for filesystem operations.
Cover the cross-form pairs with a unit test and both mixed spellings
with a Windows test that still rejects nothing it used to accept.

Keep verbatim spelling for symlink-resolved targets

resolve_existing_directory re-spelled a canonicalized symlink target
with the operand's ordinary form. A verbatim-only target name
(trailing dots or spaces) then missed on the next lookup, and the
export aborted or wrote beside the link target. Keep the canonical
spelling when the ordinary spelling no longer reaches the directory;
ordinary operands keep ordinary spelling everywhere else.
Add a Windows regression test that writes through an ordinary
directory symlink to a literal target.

Assert the emitted image URL in the trailing-dot test

The trailing-dot test proved where the file lands but not what
relative_url emits for the link. Pin assets./probe.svg for both the
ordinary and the verbatim spelling, the spelling Win32 resolves to
the directory the file landed in.

preserved_valid_changes: The package-install prerequisite is present in the root README and both generated crate README copies. This worker's obsolete README draft is withdrawn.
The new drive-volume and literal-target tests remain part of the maintained snapshot; their native outcomes have not yet been observed by this worker.
unresolved_behavior_questions: The external UNC resolution asserts no failing case was shown. Historical native run 45958671740 contains the frozen UNC failure on the previous renderer; the unchanged witness must now be observed on this exact external head.

The external trailing-dot test now expects assets./probe.svg for ordinary and explicit-verbatim input. The frozen normalized-URL witness expects the normalized ordinary directory name and a literal explicit-verbatim name. Record both existing tests and the unchanged native witness before proposing any correction.

The external canonical-target fallback checks whether an ordinary spelling exists. Source inspection alone does not prove that it has the same directory identity as the canonical target if both literal and trimmed directories exist. This is an unexecuted source-derived concern, not a new demonstrated defect.

second.meaning: Expected-failure observation harness, not repaired source.

retirement.action: removed in this additive evidence commit
